label: Exact profile probabilities by product measure computation (inference)
rule: Measure.prod_prod, Measure.pi_pi and coordinate-evaluation measure preservation on finite discrete spaces
meaning: Rewrites each assertion event as a product box and evaluates it with Mathlib's product and pi measures; the some-failure event is the complement of all-true. The product independence is the stipulated model, not a derived property of any actual assertions.
